description: Get real-time flight status for a flight number or tail number: origin/destination airports, scheduled/estimated/actual departure & arrival times, current status, and aircraft type. Returns a flights[] array (one flight ident can map to several dated flights). Example: flightaware_flight_status({ ident: "UAL123", _apiKey: "your-key" })

ident.description: Flight identifier — airline flight number (ICAO preferred, e.g. "UAL123" for United 123) or aircraft registration / tail number (e.g. "N12345").

ident_type.description: Optional. How to interpret `ident`: "designator" (flight number), "registration" (tail number), or "fa_flight_id". Omit to let AeroAPI infer.

start.description: Optional ISO8601 date/time lower bound, e.g. "2026-07-01" or "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z".

name: flightaware_flight_status
title: Flightaware Flight Status
